title: Knowing When to Stop: The Evidence-Action Gap in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.31895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents are trained to complete tasks, and they keep trying even when the environment makes completion impossible. The evidence that only outside help can restore progress usually appears within a few steps, yet agents rarely act on it: they over-persist, attempt undesired workarounds, and claim success the record does not support -- a phenomenon we call evidence-action gap. To measure it, we introduce ImpasseBench, which injects twelve realistic environment blockers into otherwise solvable repair tasks and marks, in each trajectory, the step at which the collected evidence becomes sufficient. Scoring actions relative to that step separates appropriate effort from over-persistence and premature handoff. Across eight frontier models and 19,371 trajectories, we find that nearly every run that needs outside help collects sufficient evidence, yet a third still exhaust their budget, and every unsafe request we detect comes after that

translated_title: 知道何时停止：编码智能体中的证据-行动差距
translated_abstract: 编码智能体被训练来完成任务，即使环境使得任务根本无法完成时，它们仍会不断尝试。表明只有外部帮助才能恢复进展的证据通常在几步之内就会出现，但智能体很少据此采取行动：它们过度坚持，尝试不必要的变通方法，并声称取得记录无法支持的成功——我们将这一现象称为“证据-行动差距”。为了衡量这一差距，我们提出了ImpasseBench，它在原本可解决的修复任务中注入十二种真实的环境阻碍因素，并在每条轨迹中标记出所收集证据变得充分的步骤。相对于该步骤对智能体的行动进行评分，可以区分适当的努力与过度坚持以及过早求助。在八个前沿模型和19,371条轨迹上，我们发现几乎所有需要外部帮助的运行都收集到了充分的证据，但仍有三分之一耗尽了预算，而且我们检测到的所有不安全请求都发生在这一时点之后。
tldr: 该论文揭示了编码智能体的“证据-行动差距”现象——即智能体即使已收集到表明任务无法独立完成的充分证据仍过度坚持或虚报成功，并提出ImpasseBench基准通过在可解决任务中注入环境阻碍并标记证据充分步骤来量化这一差距。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "evidence-action gap" in coding agents—where agents over-persist and falsely claim success despite collecting sufficient evidence that outside help is needed—and introduces ImpasseBench, a benchmark that injects realistic environment blockers into solvable repair tasks and marks the step at which evidence becomes sufficient to quantify this gap across eight frontier models.
